metadata.description: Let Claude operate and configure VMware Workstation / Player virtual machines (Windows XP to 11, Server 2003 to 2025) from the host.

plugins.name: vmware-vm-control
plugins.description: Windows hosts. Screen, mouse and keyboard through VMware's embedded VNC; commands, files, processes, power, snapshots and every .vmx setting through vmrun. Zero-config: finds VMs by name, secures VNC, asks the guest login in the native Windows credential dialog.
